constitutive_law.paper_Eq4: k(e)=k0*exp((e-e0)/Ck); first implementation scalar isotropic,not the different algebraic n^3/(1-n)^2 law.
constitutive_law.units_and_domain: k0 and k are HydraulicConductivity in m/s,not intrinsic permeability in m^2; Ck is dimensionless,finite and strictly positive for this selected law. Ck=2 is a cited paper example,not an implemented default. Require finite k0>=0,valid saturated J/n and representable finite k. For k0=0 return exact0 rather than evaluating0*exp(overflow). No silent clamp or threshold relaxation.
constitutive_law.state: No new independently integrated physical k state. Derive k from the same force-stage J/n; a temporary derived-k scratch may avoid exp inside every neighbor pair but is not an evolution equation. Mirror/periodic values follow the same reconstructed/copied J and law,not a separately interpolated or stale k field.

complete_rate_requirement: q=-k/gamma*(Gp+rho_w*Ace),a_s=Ace+g and p_dot=Kw/n*(-theta-div(q)). For smooth scalar k and constant gamma this requires [k*(Lstar(p)+rho_w*div(Ace))+Gk.(Gp+rho_w*Ace)]/gamma. Multiplying the old entire constant-k operator byki misses the second term. Keep current same-stage volume/storage/mixture inertia and all existing admissibility guards.
discrete_design_limit: The product-rule expression can be an initial smooth-k component diagnostic,but is not a proof of a conservative interface flux; the present affine-corrected Lstar itself is not pair-conservative. Paper Eq25 uses arithmetic pair k in pressure/gravity sums and acceleration differences; one must not assume that blindly copying pairk*(aj-ai) represents general div(k*A),which has a nonzero gradient-k term for constantA. Discontinuous scalar interfaces require an independently checked flux-form/transmissibility design (harmonic series resistance in1D),plus consistency/well-balancing rather thanki*Lstar or a nested-first-gradient substitute.
